course_name_en: Automotive Body Engineering and Lightweight Construction

learning_outcomes.text: know the basic idea of automotive body engineering, as well as body styles like sedan, station wagon, convertible;
know the most important body structures: panel, plate, profile construction;
know the calculation methodology for shear fields and frame grids;
understand the basic concepts of stability failure, strength, and stiffness in automotive engineering;
be able to calculate and design structural components such as side wall frames, vehicle understructures, and body-in-white;
be able to make a statement on the construction method of vehicles and their body system;
understand the fundamental body construction methods: shell technology, space frame, and hang-on parts.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts of automotive body engineering and definition of body-in-white
Structural analysis, shear field, frame grid
Torsional and bending stiffness of automotive bodies and their dynamic vibration behavior
Steel and aluminum as materials in automotive body engineering
Passive safety and body behavior in a crash
Basic concepts of joining technology, specifically punch riveting, self-piercing riveting, and spot welding
Introduction of body tuning concepts and profile theory
Product development process and basic design concepts
